channel.title: Azure Updates
channel.description: Azure updates: product announcements, general availability and previews.

item.title: [Launched] Generally available: Azure Kubernetes Service Automatic in more regions
item.description:
AKS Automatic is now generally available in 12 additional Azure regions.

It sets up node pools, scaling and networking for you.

item.title: [In preview] Public preview: Azure Functions Flex Consumption supports Python 3.14
item.description: Python 3.14 is now available on the Flex Consumption plan in public preview.

item.title: [Retirement] Retirement notice: Azure Cache for Redis Basic tier on 30 September 2027
item.description: Move to Azure Managed Redis before the retirement date.

item.title: [Launched] Generally available: Azure SQL Database hyperscale elastic pools
item.description: Elastic pools for Hyperscale are generally available.
